---- MODULE ZkV3_7_0 ----
EXTENDS ZkV3_7_0Defs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
\* Leadership is proved using a projection that retains roles, epoch promises,
\* handshake tables, and the shapes of the pre-election message queues.
\* Once a leader has a quorum, payload actions need only preserve that
\* projection; the transaction histories are not assumptions of this proof.
\*
\* A claim is either a sticky election vote or an eligible acknowledgement
\* in transit. A newly acquired claim strictly raises its server's epoch
\* promise. Intersecting quorums therefore exclude different leaders for
\* the same epoch. Historical quorum certificates also cover epochLeader.
LOCAL AGFinite == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems

AGDomain(f, S) == f = [x \in S |-> f[x]]
AGMatrix(f) == f = [x \in Server |-> [y \in Server |-> f[x][y]]]
AGSids(S) == {x.sid : x \in S}
AGVoters(S) == {x.sid : x \in {r \in S : r.inQuorum = TRUE}}
AGUnique(S) == \A x, y \in S : x.sid = y.sid => x = y
AGReady(i) == IsLeader(i) /\ i \in AGSids(connecting[i])
              /\ AGSids(connecting[i]) \in Quorums
AGDone(i) == IsLeader(i) /\ i \in AGVoters(electing[i])
             /\ AGVoters(electing[i]) \in Quorums
AGLink(i,j) == \/ /\ IsLeader(i) /\ IsFollower(j)
                   /\ connectInfo[j].sid = i /\ j \in learners[i]
               \/ /\ IsLeader(j) /\ IsFollower(i)
                   /\ connectInfo[i].sid = j /\ i \in learners[j]

AGDown(i,j) ==
  \/ msgs[i][j] = << >>
  \/ /\ msgs[i][j] = <<msgs[i][j][1]>>
     /\ msgs[i][j][1].mtype = LEADERINFO
     /\ msgs[i][j][1].mzxid = <<acceptedEpoch[i],0>>
     /\ AGReady(i)

AGUp(i,j) ==
  \/ msgs[j][i] = << >>
  \/ /\ msgs[j][i] = <<msgs[j][i][1]>>
     /\ \/ /\ msgs[j][i][1].mtype = FOLLOWERINFO
           /\ msgs[j][i][1].mzxid = <<acceptedEpoch[j],0>>
           /\ zabState[j] = DISCOVERY
        \/ /\ msgs[j][i][1].mtype = ACKEPOCH
           /\ msgs[j][i][1].mepoch \in Nat \union {-1}
           /\ zabState[j] = SYNCHRONIZATION
           /\ acceptedEpoch[j] = acceptedEpoch[i]
           /\ AGReady(i)

AGControlTypes ==
  /\ state \in [Server -> {LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING}]
  /\ zabState \in [Server -> {ELECTION, DISCOVERY, SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST}]
  /\ learners \in [Server -> SUBSET Server]
  /\ connectInfo \in [Server ->
       [sid : Server \union {NullPoint}, syncMode : {NONE, DIFF, TRUNC, SNAP},
        nlRcv : BOOLEAN]]
  /\ AGMatrix(msgs)

AGNode(i) ==
  /\ IF IsLeader(i) THEN i \in learners[i] ELSE learners[i] = {}
  /\ ~IsFollower(i) => connectInfo[i].sid = NullPoint
  /\ (IsLeader(i) \/ IsFollower(i)) => zabState[i] # ELECTION
  /\ (IsFollower(i) /\ connectInfo[i].sid # NullPoint) =>
       /\ IsLeader(connectInfo[i].sid)
       /\ i \in learners[connectInfo[i].sid]
  /\ \A j \in learners[i] \ {i} :
       /\ IsLeader(i) /\ IsFollower(j) /\ connectInfo[j].sid = i

AGStructure ==
  /\ AGControlTypes
  /\ (\A i \in Server : AGNode(i))
  /\ (\A i,j \in Server : msgs[i][j] # << >> => AGLink(i,j))

AGPhaseTypes ==
  /\ acceptedEpoch \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ currentEpoch \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ tempMaxEpoch \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ AGDomain(connecting, Server)
  /\ AGDomain(electing, Server)
  /\ AGDomain(ackldRecv, Server)
  /\ forwarding \in [Server -> SUBSET Server]

AGPhaseNode(i) ==
  /\ AGSids(connecting[i]) \subseteq Server
  /\ AGUnique(connecting[i])
  /\ AGSids(electing[i]) \subseteq Server
  /\ AGUnique(electing[i])
  /\ AGUnique(ackldRecv[i])
  /\ AGSids(ackldRecv[i]) \subseteq Server
  /\ (\A r \in electing[i] : r.inQuorum \in BOOLEAN)
  /\ IsLeader(i) =>
       /\ i \in AGSids(connecting[i])
       /\ i \in AGVoters(electing[i])
       /\ forwarding[i] \subseteq learners[i]
       /\ \A j \in forwarding[i] \ {i} :
            zabState[j] \in {SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST}
       /\ \A c \in connecting[i] :
            (c.sid # i /\ c.connected = TRUE) =>
              /\ c.sid \in learners[i]
              /\ (zabState[c.sid] = DISCOVERY => msgs[c.sid][i] = << >>)
       /\ \A a \in ackldRecv[i] :
            (a.sid # i /\ a.connected = TRUE) =>
              /\ a.sid \in learners[i]
              /\ zabState[a.sid] \in {SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST}
       /\ ~AGReady(i) =>
            /\ tempMaxEpoch[i] > acceptedEpoch[i]
            /\ AGVoters(electing[i]) = {i}
       /\ zabState[i] \in {SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST} => AGDone(i)
       /\ \A r \in electing[i] :
            ~ZxidEqual(r.peerLastZxid, <<-1,-1>>) =>
              /\ r.sid # i /\ r.sid \in learners[i]
              /\ zabState[r.sid] \in {SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST}
  /\ (IsFollower(i) /\ zabState[i] # DISCOVERY) =>
       /\ connectInfo[i].sid # NullPoint
       /\ AGReady(connectInfo[i].sid)
       /\ (zabState[i] = BROADCAST => AGDone(connectInfo[i].sid))

AGTableAttrs(i) ==
  /\ AGSids(connecting[i]) \subseteq Server
  /\ AGUnique(connecting[i])
  /\ AGSids(electing[i]) \subseteq Server
  /\ AGUnique(electing[i])
  /\ AGUnique(ackldRecv[i])
  /\ AGSids(ackldRecv[i]) \subseteq Server
  /\ (\A r \in electing[i] : r.inQuorum \in BOOLEAN)

AGLeaderAttrs(i) ==
  IsLeader(i) =>
       /\ i \in AGSids(connecting[i])
       /\ i \in AGVoters(electing[i])
       /\ forwarding[i] \subseteq learners[i]
       /\ \A j \in forwarding[i] \ {i} :
            zabState[j] \in {SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST}
       /\ \A c \in connecting[i] :
            (c.sid # i /\ c.connected = TRUE) =>
              /\ c.sid \in learners[i]
              /\ (zabState[c.sid] = DISCOVERY => msgs[c.sid][i] = << >>)
       /\ \A a \in ackldRecv[i] :
            (a.sid # i /\ a.connected = TRUE) =>
              /\ a.sid \in learners[i]
              /\ zabState[a.sid] \in {SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST}
       /\ ~AGReady(i) =>
            /\ tempMaxEpoch[i] > acceptedEpoch[i]
            /\ AGVoters(electing[i]) = {i}
       /\ zabState[i] \in {SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST} => AGDone(i)
       /\ \A r \in electing[i] :
            ~ZxidEqual(r.peerLastZxid, <<-1,-1>>) =>
              /\ r.sid # i /\ r.sid \in learners[i]
              /\ zabState[r.sid] \in {SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST}

AGFollowerAttrs(i) ==
  (IsFollower(i) /\ zabState[i] # DISCOVERY) =>
       /\ connectInfo[i].sid # NullPoint
       /\ AGReady(connectInfo[i].sid)
       /\ (zabState[i] = BROADCAST => AGDone(connectInfo[i].sid))

AGPhaseMessages(i,j) ==
  (IsLeader(i) /\ IsFollower(j) /\ connectInfo[j].sid = i /\
   (~AGDone(i) \/ zabState[j] = DISCOVERY)) =>
     /\ AGDown(i,j) /\ AGUp(i,j)
     /\ (msgs[i][j] = << >> \/ msgs[j][i] = << >>)

AGPhases ==
  /\ AGPhaseTypes
  /\ (\A i \in Server : AGPhaseNode(i))
  /\ (\A i,j \in Server : AGPhaseMessages(i,j))

AGControl == AGStructure /\ AGPhases

AGClaims(i) ==
  IF AGReady(i) THEN AGVoters(electing[i]) \union
      {s \in Server : /\ ~AGDone(i)
                       /\ msgs[s][i] # << >>
                       /\ msgs[s][i][1].mtype = ACKEPOCH
                       /\ msgs[s][i][1].mepoch > -1}
  ELSE {}

AGClaimSafety ==
  /\ \A i \in Server : \A s \in AGClaims(i) :
       /\ s \in Server /\ acceptedEpoch[s] >= acceptedEpoch[i]
  /\ \A i,j \in Server :
       (i # j /\ acceptedEpoch[i] = acceptedEpoch[j]) =>
         AGClaims(i) \intersect AGClaims(j) = {}

AGEpochCertificate ==
  /\ epochLeader \in [1..MAXEPOCH -> SUBSET Server]
  /\ \A e \in 1..MAXEPOCH :
       \/ epochLeader[e] = {}
       \/ \E l \in Server, Q \in Quorums :
            /\ epochLeader[e] = {l}
            /\ \A s \in Q :
                 /\ acceptedEpoch[s] >= e
                 /\ \A i \in Server :
                      (acceptedEpoch[i] = e /\ s \in AGClaims(i)) => i = l

AGLeadershipInvariant == AGControl /\ AGClaimSafety /\ AGEpochCertificate

AGClaimAdvance ==
  /\ (\A s \in Server : acceptedEpoch'[s] >= acceptedEpoch[s])
  /\ \E owner \in Server \union {NullPoint} :
       \A i \in Server : \A s \in AGClaims(i)' :
         \/ /\ acceptedEpoch'[i] = acceptedEpoch[i] /\ s \in AGClaims(i)
         \/ /\ i = owner /\ acceptedEpoch[s] < acceptedEpoch'[i]
            /\ s \in Server /\ acceptedEpoch'[s] >= acceptedEpoch'[i]

LEMMA AGUpdateConnectingSids ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW s
  PROVE AGSids(UpdateConnectingOrAckldRecv(S,s)) = AGSids(S) \union {s}
BY SMTT("r10") DEF AGSids, UpdateConnectingOrAckldRecv

LEMMA AGRemoveConnectingSids ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW s
  PROVE AGSids(RemoveConnectingOrAckldRecv(S,s)) = AGSids(S)
BY SMTT("r10") DEF AGSids, RemoveConnectingOrAckldRecv

LEMMA AGUpdateElectingSets ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW s, NEW z, NEW b \in BOOLEAN,
         \A r \in S : r.inQuorum \in BOOLEAN
  PROVE /\ AGSids(UpdateElecting(S,s,z,b)) = AGSids(S) \union {s}
        /\ AGVoters(UpdateElecting(S,s,z,b)) =
             AGVoters(S) \union (IF b THEN {s} ELSE {})
        /\ (\A r \in UpdateElecting(S,s,z,b) : r.inQuorum \in BOOLEAN)
        /\ (AGUnique(S) => AGUnique(UpdateElecting(S,s,z,b)))
BY SMTT("r20") DEF AGSids, AGVoters, AGUnique, UpdateElecting

LEMMA AGRemoveElectingSets ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW s,
         \A r \in S : r.inQuorum \in BOOLEAN
  PROVE /\ AGSids(RemoveElecting(S,s)) = AGSids(S)
        /\ AGVoters(RemoveElecting(S,s)) = AGVoters(S)
        /\ (\A r \in RemoveElecting(S,s) : r.inQuorum \in BOOLEAN)
        /\ (AGUnique(S) => AGUnique(RemoveElecting(S,s)))
BY SMTT("r20") DEF AGSids, AGVoters, AGUnique, RemoveElecting

LEMMA AGControlInit == Init => AGControl
BY SMTT("r20") DEF Init, InitServerVars, InitServerVarsL, InitLeaderVars,
  InitLeaderVarsL, InitFollowerVars, InitMsgVars, AGControl, AGStructure, AGControlTypes, AGNode,
  AGPhases, AGPhaseTypes, AGPhaseNode, AGPhaseMessages, AGDomain, AGMatrix, AGSids, AGVoters, AGUnique, AGReady, AGDone,
  AGLink, AGDown, AGUp, IsLeader, IsFollower,
  LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING, ELECTION, DISCOVERY, SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST,
  NONE, DIFF, TRUNC, SNAP

LEMMA AGFiniteBridge ==
  \A S : /\ AGFinite!Cardinality(S) = Cardinality(S)
         /\ AGFinite!IsFiniteSet(S) = IsFiniteSet(S)
BY Zenon DEF AGFinite!Cardinality, Cardinality, AGFinite!IsFiniteSet, IsFiniteSet

LEMMA AGSingletonNotQuorum ==
  ASSUME Cardinality(Server) >= 2, NEW i
  PROVE {i} \notin Quorums
<1>1. Cardinality(Server) \in Nat
  BY ServerFinite, AGFiniteBridge, AGFinite!FS_CardinalityType
<1>2. Cardinality({i}) = 1
  BY AGFiniteBridge, AGFinite!FS_Singleton
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, SMTT("r5") DEF Quorums

LEMMA AGDoneReady ==
  ASSUME Cardinality(Server) >= 2, AGPhases, NEW i \in Server, AGDone(i)
  PROVE AGReady(i)
BY AGSingletonNotQuorum, SMTT("r5") DEF AGPhases, AGPhaseTypes, AGPhaseNode, AGPhaseMessages, AGDone

LEMMA AGFLEFrame ==
  ASSUME NEW i \in Server, state[i] = LOOKING,
         state \in [Server -> {LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING}],
         HandleNotmsg(i) \/ WaitNewNotmsg(i)
  PROVE /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![i] = state'[i]]
        /\ state'[i] \in {LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING}
        /\ currentEpoch' = currentEpoch
BY SMTT("r20") DEF HandleNotmsg, WaitNewNotmsg,
  ReceivedFollowingAndLeadingNotification, serverVarsL,
  LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING

AGControlElectionShape(i) ==
  /\ state[i] = LOOKING
  /\ state'[i] \in {LOOKING, LEADING, FOLLOWING}
  /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![i] = state'[i]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<currentEpoch, acceptedEpoch, connectInfo, msgs>>
  /\ zabState' = IF state'[i] = LOOKING THEN zabState
                   ELSE [zabState EXCEPT ![i] = DISCOVERY]
  /\ learners' = IF state'[i] = LEADING THEN [learners EXCEPT ![i] = {i}]
                   ELSE learners
  /\ connecting' = IF state'[i] = LEADING THEN
          [connecting EXCEPT ![i] = {[sid |-> i, connected |-> TRUE]}]
          ELSE connecting
  /\ electing' = IF state'[i] = LEADING THEN
          [electing EXCEPT ![i] =
            {[sid |-> i, peerLastZxid |-> <<-1,-1>>, inQuorum |-> TRUE]}]
          ELSE electing
  /\ ackldRecv' = IF state'[i] = LEADING THEN
          [ackldRecv EXCEPT ![i] = {[sid |-> i, connected |-> TRUE]}]
          ELSE ackldRecv
  /\ forwarding' = IF state'[i] = LEADING THEN [forwarding EXCEPT ![i] = {}]
                    ELSE forwarding
  /\ tempMaxEpoch' = IF state'[i] = LEADING THEN
          [tempMaxEpoch EXCEPT ![i] = acceptedEpoch[i] + 1]
          ELSE tempMaxEpoch

LEMMA AGControlElectionProject ==
  ASSUME NEW i \in Server, AGControl,
         FLEHandleNotmsg(i) \/ FLEWaitNewNotmsg(i)
  PROVE AGControlElectionShape(i)
<1>1. state[i] = LOOKING
  BY SMTT("r2") DEF FLEHandleNotmsg, FLEWaitNewNotmsg,
    HandleNotmsg, WaitNewNotmsg
<1>2. /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![i] = state'[i]]
      /\ state'[i] \in {LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING}
      /\ currentEpoch' = currentEpoch
  BY <1>1, AGFLEFrame DEF FLEHandleNotmsg, FLEWaitNewNotmsg, AGControl, AGStructure, AGControlTypes, AGNode
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, SMTT("r3")
    DEF AGControlElectionShape, FLEHandleNotmsg, FLEWaitNewNotmsg,
    ZabTurnToLeading, ZabTurnToFollowing, LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING

LEMMA AGControlElection ==
  ASSUME Cardinality(Server) >= 2, NEW i \in Server, AGControl,
         FLEHandleNotmsg(i) \/ FLEWaitNewNotmsg(i)
  PROVE AGControl'
<1>1. AGControlElectionShape(i)
  BY AGControlElectionProject
<1>2. {i} \notin Quorums
  BY AGSingletonNotQuorum
<1>3. AGControlTypes'
  <2>1. state' \in [Server -> {LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING}]
    BY <1>1, SMTT("r2") DEF AGControlElectionShape, AGControl, AGStructure,
      AGControlTypes
  <2>2. zabState' \in [Server -> {ELECTION, DISCOVERY, SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST}]
    BY <1>1, SMTT("r2") DEF AGControlElectionShape, AGControl, AGStructure,
      AGControlTypes
  <2>3. learners' \in [Server -> SUBSET Server]
    BY <1>1, SMTT("r2") DEF AGControlElectionShape, AGControl, AGStructure,
      AGControlTypes
  <2>4. QED
    BY <1>1, <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, SMTT("r2")
      DEF AGControlElectionShape, AGControl, AGStructure, AGControlTypes, AGMatrix
<1>4. \A s \in Server : AGNode(s)'
  <2>1. TAKE s \in Server
  <2>2. CASE s = i
    BY <1>1, <1>3, <2>2, NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r3")
      DEF AGControlElectionShape, AGControl, AGStructure, AGControlTypes,
      AGNode, IsLeader, IsFollower, LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING,
      ELECTION, DISCOVERY, SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST
  <2>3. CASE s # i
    BY <1>1, <1>3, <2>3, NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r3")
      DEF AGControlElectionShape, AGControl, AGStructure, AGControlTypes,
      AGNode, IsLeader, IsFollower, LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING,
      ELECTION, DISCOVERY, SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST
  <2>4. QED BY <2>2, <2>3
<1>5. \A s,t \in Server : msgs'[s][t] # << >> => AGLink(s,t)'
  <2>1. TAKE s \in Server, t \in Server
  <2>2. QED
    BY <1>1, <1>3, SMTT("r3")
      DEF AGControlElectionShape, AGControl, AGStructure, AGControlTypes,
      AGLink, IsLeader, IsFollower, LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING
<1>6. AGStructure'
  BY <1>3, <1>4, <1>5 DEF AGStructure
<1>7. \A s \in Server \ {i} :
        /\ state'[s] = state[s] /\ zabState'[s] = zabState[s]
        /\ learners'[s] = learners[s] /\ connecting'[s] = connecting[s]
        /\ electing'[s] = electing[s] /\ ackldRecv'[s] = ackldRecv[s]
        /\ forwarding'[s] = forwarding[s] /\ tempMaxEpoch'[s] = tempMaxEpoch[s]
        /\ AGReady(s)' = AGReady(s)
        /\ AGDone(s)' = AGDone(s)
  BY <1>1, SMTT("r3")
    DEF AGControlElectionShape, AGControl, AGStructure, AGControlTypes,
    AGPhases, AGPhaseTypes, AGDomain, AGReady, AGDone, IsLeader
<1>8. state'[i] = LEADING =>
        /\ AGSids(connecting'[i]) = {i}
        /\ AGVoters(electing'[i]) = {i}
  BY <1>1, SMTT("r3")
    DEF AGControlElectionShape, AGControl, AGStructure, AGControlTypes,
    AGPhases, AGPhaseTypes, AGDomain, AGSids, AGVoters
<1>9. /\ ~AGReady(i)' /\ ~AGDone(i)'
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>8, SMTT("r2")
    DEF AGControlElectionShape, AGReady, AGDone, IsLeader
<1>10. AGPhaseTypes'
  BY <1>1, SMTT("r3")
    DEF AGControlElectionShape, AGControl, AGPhases, AGPhaseTypes, AGDomain
<1>11. \A s \in Server : AGPhaseNode(s)'
  <2>1. TAKE s \in Server
  <2>2. CASE s = i
    BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>7, <1>8, <1>9, <1>10, <2>2,
       NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r5")
      DEF AGControlElectionShape, AGControl, AGStructure, AGControlTypes,
      AGNode, AGPhases, AGPhaseTypes, AGPhaseNode, AGDomain,
      AGSids, AGVoters, AGUnique, IsLeader, IsFollower, ZxidEqual,
      LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING, ELECTION, DISCOVERY, SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST
  <2>3. CASE s # i
    <3>1. IsLeader(s) => i \notin learners[s]
      BY <1>1, <2>3, SMTT("r2")
        DEF AGControlElectionShape, AGControl, AGStructure, AGControlTypes,
        AGNode, IsLeader, IsFollower, LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING
    <3>2. (IsFollower(s) /\ connectInfo[s].sid # NullPoint) =>
             connectInfo[s].sid # i
      BY <1>1, <2>3, SMTT("r2")
        DEF AGControlElectionShape, AGControl, AGStructure, AGControlTypes,
        AGNode, IsLeader, LOOKING, LEADING
    <3>3. /\ AGPhaseNode(s) /\ AGPhaseTypes /\ AGControlTypes
           /\ s \in Server /\ s # i
      BY <2>3 DEF AGControl, AGStructure, AGPhases
    <3>4. QED
      BY ONLY <1>1, <1>7, <3>1, <3>2, <3>3, SMTT("r5")
        DEF AGControlElectionShape, AGControlTypes,
        AGPhaseTypes, AGPhaseNode, AGDomain, AGReady, AGDone,
        AGSids, AGVoters, IsLeader, IsFollower
  <2>4. QED BY <2>2, <2>3
<1>12. \A s,t \in Server : AGPhaseMessages(s,t)'
  <2>1. TAKE s \in Server, t \in Server
  <2>2. QED
    BY <1>1, <1>3, <1>7, <1>9, NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r5")
      DEF AGControlElectionShape, AGControl, AGStructure, AGControlTypes,
      AGNode, AGPhases, AGPhaseMessages, AGLink, AGUp, AGDown,
      IsLeader, IsFollower, LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING
<1>13. QED
  BY <1>6, <1>10, <1>11, <1>12 DEF AGControl, AGPhases

LEMMA AGQuorumsMeet ==
  ASSUME NEW Q \in Quorums, NEW R \in Quorums
  PROVE Q \intersect R # {}
<1>1. /\ Q \subseteq Server /\ R \subseteq Server
      /\ IsFiniteSet(Q) /\ IsFiniteSet(R)
  BY ServerFinite, AGFiniteBridge, AGFinite!FS_Subset, SMTT("r2") DEF Quorums
<1>2. /\ Cardinality(Q) \in Nat /\ Cardinality(R) \in Nat
      /\ Cardinality(Server) \in Nat
  BY <1>1, ServerFinite, AGFiniteBridge, AGFinite!FS_CardinalityType
<1>3. Cardinality(Q) + Cardinality(R) > Cardinality(Server)
  BY <1>2, SMTT("r2") DEF Quorums
<1>4. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>3, ServerFinite, AGFiniteBridge, AGFinite!FS_MajoritiesIntersect

LEMMA AGClaimsRemainSafe ==
  ASSUME acceptedEpoch \in [Server -> Nat],
         acceptedEpoch' \in [Server -> Nat], AGClaimSafety, AGClaimAdvance
  PROVE AGClaimSafety'
<1>1. PICK owner \in Server \union {NullPoint} :
       \A i \in Server : \A s \in AGClaims(i)' :
         \/ /\ acceptedEpoch'[i] = acceptedEpoch[i] /\ s \in AGClaims(i)
         \/ /\ i = owner /\ acceptedEpoch[s] < acceptedEpoch'[i]
            /\ s \in Server /\ acceptedEpoch'[s] >= acceptedEpoch'[i]
  BY DEF AGClaimAdvance
<1>2. \A i \in Server : \A s \in AGClaims(i)' :
        /\ s \in Server /\ acceptedEpoch'[s] >= acceptedEpoch'[i]
  BY <1>1, SMTT("r3") DEF AGClaimSafety, AGClaimAdvance
<1>3. \A i,j \in Server :
       (i # j /\ acceptedEpoch'[i] = acceptedEpoch'[j]) =>
         (AGClaims(i)') \intersect (AGClaims(j)') = {}
  <2>1. TAKE i \in Server, j \in Server
  <2>2. QED
    BY <1>1, SMTT("r3") DEF AGClaimSafety, AGClaimAdvance
<1>4. QED BY <1>2, <1>3 DEF AGClaimSafety

LEMMA AGCertificatesPersist ==
  ASSUME acceptedEpoch \in [Server -> Nat],
         acceptedEpoch' \in [Server -> Nat], AGEpochCertificate, AGClaimAdvance
  PROVE \A e \in 1..MAXEPOCH : epochLeader[e] # {} =>
          \E l \in Server, Q \in Quorums :
            /\ epochLeader[e] = {l}
            /\ \A s \in Q :
                 /\ acceptedEpoch'[s] >= e
                 /\ \A i \in Server :
                      (acceptedEpoch'[i] = e /\ s \in AGClaims(i)') => i = l
<1>1. TAKE e \in 1..MAXEPOCH
<1>2. ASSUME epochLeader[e] # {}
      PROVE \E l \in Server, Q \in Quorums :
              /\ epochLeader[e] = {l}
              /\ \A s \in Q :
                   /\ acceptedEpoch'[s] >= e
                   /\ \A i \in Server :

AGDataShape(i) ==
  /\ AGDone(i)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<state, learners, acceptedEpoch, connecting, tempMaxEpoch>>
  /\ currentEpoch' \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ zabState' \in [Server -> {ELECTION, DISCOVERY, SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST}]
  /\ connectInfo' \in [Server ->
       [sid : Server \union {NullPoint}, syncMode : {NONE, DIFF, TRUNC, SNAP}, nlRcv : BOOLEAN]]
  /\ \A s \in Server :
       /\ connectInfo'[s].sid = connectInfo[s].sid
       /\ (zabState'[s] # zabState[s] =>
             /\ (s = i \/ AGEstablished(i,s)) /\ zabState'[s] = BROADCAST)
  /\ AGMatrix(msgs')
  /\ (\A s,t \in Server : msgs'[s][t] # msgs[s][t] => AGCompletedLink(i,s,t))
  /\ AGDomain(electing', Server) /\ AGDomain(ackldRecv', Server)
  /\ forwarding' \in [Server -> SUBSET Server]
  /\ \A s \in Server :
       /\ AGSids(electing'[s]) \subseteq Server /\ AGUnique(electing'[s])
       /\ (\A r \in electing'[s] : r.inQuorum \in BOOLEAN)
       /\ AGVoters(electing'[s]) = AGVoters(electing[s])
       /\ AGSids(ackldRecv'[s]) \subseteq Server /\ AGUnique(ackldRecv'[s])
       /\ (s # i => /\ electing'[s] = electing[s]
                     /\ ackldRecv'[s] = ackldRecv[s]
                     /\ forwarding'[s] = forwarding[s])
  /\ forwarding'[i] \subseteq learners[i]
  /\ (\A s \in forwarding'[i] \ {i} : AGEstablished(i,s))
  /\ \A a \in ackldRecv'[i] :
       (a.sid # i /\ a.connected = TRUE) => AGEstablished(i,a.sid)
  /\ \A r \in electing'[i] :
       ~ZxidEqual(r.peerLastZxid, <<-1,-1>>) => AGEstablished(i,r.sid)
